cases.summary: Hotkey setter treats backtick as tilde.
cases.description:
Using a backtick in hotkeys doesn't work because it gets converted into a tilde.

For example, if you want `` Ctrl + ` `` as the toggle key, it will be registered as `Ctrl + ~`.

Editing the config file directly works as a workaround.

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fix hotkey setter to handle backticks and tildes properly
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix hotkey setter to handle backticks and tildes properly

This fixes #4006.
